selected_architecture: laser-cut birch internal skeleton with two lower carbon longerons continuous to X=-475, upper carbon longerons aft of X=-170, primary birch side rails around the forward hatch, local 3-mm birch hardpoint boxes and secondary foam/light-composite outer shell

secondary: battery/equipment trays where not on retention path

battery.removal: upward after guarded disconnect; mock-up and six-direction inert-dummy proof required

retention.path_rule: each complete stop or strap path is proofed for the full load; no failed-path load-sharing credit

boom_interface.status: provisional alignment/motor bridge only; no primary boom bending-load credit until coupled wing/boom interface CAD and proof

fuselage_mass.centroid_note: Single point reconciled to hardware ledger; its moment is -636.8 g mm. The separate 50-g removable motor plate/adapter/prop-retention item is not included.

motor_mount_proof_screen.basis: 1.5x 10.1-N/0.84-Nm provisional propulsion screen and 4g on 180g at 90mm; replace with selected-motor bench loads

primary_failure_modes: bond peel at inadequately prepared laser-cut face
release_gates: battery dummy proof in six directions
